VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 10, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Juanita Doplemore, Chair  Sylvia Contreras, Commissioner
Kenneth Osborn, Vice Chair  Mike Shaknovich, Commissioner
Ryan Antes, Commissioner  Josh Smith, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Doplemore called meeting to order at 5:20 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith

Also present: Erica Valencia-Adachi, Collective Impact Manager, Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

Also in attendance James Goodin, new Commissioner for District 1, Christina Boatwright, Resource
Connections Division Officer, Nick Sramek, Veteran, and Antawnette Blade, Veteran.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Meeting attendees recited the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52948  Recommendation to approve minutes for Veterans Affairs Commission meeting on
  February 14, 2024 and March 26, 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Smith, Substitute Motion – Recommendation to approve minutes for February
  14, 2024. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

2.  24-52949  Recommendation to receive and file the Chair’s Report for March 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner

  Page 1 of 3
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES

  Smith, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  24-52950  Recommendation to receive and file the Staff Report for March 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Smith, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Staff reminded Commissioners of the need to complete their required paperwork,
  such as Form 700, and Ethics training by their respective deadlines. There is a
  possibility that additional funding may be available to print up to 20 additional
  banners. Staff will complete the permit application, liaison with the banner company
  to finalize and approve the banners for printing, prepare the bios for the website
  and inform applicants of their status (accepted or rejected).

4.  24-52951  Recommendation to discuss Honoring Our Heroes: A Sunset Ceremony.

  Motion made to make Commissioner Shaknovich the chair of the event
  subcommittee. Memorial Day planning is fully underway; online subcommittee
  meetings are Mondays at 3:30 p.m. Commissioners briefly reviewed the May 26
  event components, logistics and promotion and reminded to attend the presentation
  to Council on Tuesday, May 21. Commissioners may support the event in several
  ways, from identifying potential keynote speaker(s) and volunteering on the day of
  the event, to promoting the event by inviting Councilmembers and other elected
  officials, as well as their own contacts.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Doplemore, seconded by
  Commissioner Smith, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  6 Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith
  No:  0 None

  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 0 None

5.  24-52952  Recommendation to discuss Veterans banners program.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Doplemore, seconded by
  Commissioner Shaknovich, to approve recommendation. The motion by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  6  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Commission approved recommendation to accept the 25 Veterans chosen by the
  subcommittee for the pilot Veterans banners program and to allow the
  subcommittee to move forward with additional banners if funding is identified.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Veteran Antawnette Blade inquired about the Veterans banner selection process and how to ensure
the diversity of Veterans selected for the program.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Upcoming events: Veterans Health and Resource Fair at LBCC on 4/18, Meet a Vet at the VA Long
Beach on 4/29, Sky Resilience Training May 1-5, American Gold Star Manor’s Memorial Day
Celebration on 5/24, and our own Honoring Our Heroes: A Sunset Ceremony on 5/26.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Doplemore adjourned the meeting at 6:41 p.m.
